snippet.title: How we have fixed NOX | GOG Preservation Program
snippet.description:
In 2000, Westwood Studios released Nox - a fast, frantic, spell-slinging action RPG. But running it on modern PC hardware today can feel like a technical nightmare full of black screens, violent flickering, and crash bugs.  Thanks to our GOG Patrons, Nox has officially joined the GOG Preservation Program! Watch as Adim breaks down how our technical team fixed legacy DirectDraw issues, introduced native 16:9 widescreen, restored original installer lore, and brought back online multiplayer. 

 🛒 Get Nox DRM-Free on GOG: https://bit.ly/4ypjOQR
